buyer.text:
> On Tue, Dana wrote: happy to set up a sandbox whenever you're ready

Ready now. Our security lead signed off on the vendor questionnaire yesterday, so the last blocker is gone. Can you provision a sandbox for three admins at {company} this week? We want to rebuild contractor offboarding in it before the quarter closes.

Hola, soy la jefa de operaciones. We're a fintech split between Mexico City and Bogota, about 180 people. Necesitamos automatizar aprobaciones de gastos y de accesos. Is there a Spanish-speaking rep, or someone who can walk our team through pricing in English?
Sent from my phone, sorry for typos. Saw your talk at the platform eng meetup. We have exactly the approval-chain mess you described. 400 engineers. Want a call. Thurs or Fri.

Okay this is going to be long, apologies in advance. I run IT for a cybersecurity company, a bit over 250 people now, and every new hire touches about fourteen systems in week one. Today that's a Google Sheet, a Slack channel and me personally chasing managers. Last month someone started without laptop access for three days. I've been given budget this half to fix it properly. Your onboarding checklist page looks close. Can we see it running with our actual steps?

Forwarding from our CFO below.
---
"Can we get a quote from these folks before we renew {tool}? The approvals piece alone might justify it."
---
So, yes, can we? We're {employees} people and need SSO and audit export.
Does your platform support multi-level approvals with SCIM provisioning to Okta? If yes, we'd like a trial for the IT team at {company}. Headcount around 600.

We're consolidating. Three separate tools today for access reviews, onboarding and change approvals, and procurement wants one vendor by Q2. I'm building the shortlist this week and you're on it. Send whatever you give people at this stage: security docs, pricing bands, a reference in cloud infra.

RE: webinar follow-up
Thanks for the recording. I shared it with our compliance team and they want to see the audit trail export live. We're a payments company, roughly 220 people. Could you run a 45 minute session with them next week?

TL;DR we're ripping out homegrown Jira workflows for access requests because engineering hates maintaining them. Dev tools company, 140 people, looking to pilot in October if your platform can import our existing request history.

Salut ! Notre equipe RH (HR tech, environ 95 personnes) cherche un outil pour les checklists d'onboarding et les validations. English is fine for the demo. We'd start with the Paris office, then expand to Lisbon.
We tried building this ourselves in Retool and it's held together with tape. I'd rather pay you. What does implementation look like for a 300-person SaaS company on Azure AD?

My predecessor left a note that just says 'talk to these guys about audit trails', nothing else. I'm the new head of GRC at a {industry} company with {employees} employees. Our ISO audit is in 11 weeks. Is that enough time to get you live?
Can you send an MSA and order form? We've done two demos with your team already (spoke with Marcus) and legal just wants the paperwork to redline. 350 seats to start.

Our Head of People and I both want to look at this together. HR tech company, around 120 folks and growing fast. Onboarding checklists are the priority, access requests second. When can we get 30 minutes with someone?
Is there a way to trial just the access-request module? Our infra group, about 70 SREs inside a 900-person company, wants to prove it out before the wider rollout conversation.

Following up on my own message from last week since I didn't hear back. Still very interested. We need an approvals workflow that logs every step for our regulators. Fintech lender, 260 staff, free any afternoon for a call.

Dear team, {company} is running a formal RFP for internal workflow automation, responses due on the 30th. Could you confirm a contact so we can send the documents? We have approximately 1,100 employees across four countries.
I've got {tool} for tickets but nothing for approvals and it's killing us. 85 people, B2B SaaS. What's your pricing at that size, and can I start this month?

Pitch incoming: we're a cloud cost optimization platform and your AWS bill is probably 30% higher than it needs to be. Can we get 20 minutes with your CTO? Free assessment, pricing tied to savings.
